title: 生物风险管理导论：课程路线
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/29_MOOC4DEV INTRODUCTION TO BIORISK MANAGEMENT.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/29_MOOC4DEV INTRODUCTION TO BIORISK MANAGEMENT/src.py

points.K3: 第一周：原则和关键概念
points.K4: 第一周：生物因子与分组
points.K7: 第二周：完整做一次评估

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一张五格路线图前，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a big five-step road map made of blank boxes and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理，从哪里学起？
overlay: 生物风险管理导论：课程路线

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天进微生物实验室，兴奋地想直接开始实验
shots.prompt_en: On his first day, the young male student walks into a microbiology laboratory, eager to start an experiment right away.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天进实验室，想马上动手。

shots.scene: 王老师递给他一张空白的学习计划表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands him a blank study plan sheet with five empty boxes.
shots.narration: 王老师说：先把这门课学完。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头看着计划表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head while looking at the plan.
shots.narration: 五周？都学些什么呢？

shots.scene: 欣欣指着路线图起点
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to the start of the five-step road map.
shots.narration: 这是一门五周的入门课，

shots.scene: 笔记本电脑屏幕上播放空白课程画面，阿杰戴耳机听课
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears headphones and watches a blank course video on a laptop.
shots.narration: 在线学习，讲怎么管好生物风险。

shots.scene: 日历上前四格画书本图标，第五格画试卷图标
shots.prompt_en: A five-week calendar: the first four weeks show book icons and the fifth shows a test paper icon. No people.
shots.narration: 前四周学知识，

shots.scene: 第五格单独亮起
shots.prompt_en: The fifth week box lights up on its own. No people.
shots.narration: 最后一周用来考核。

shots.section_title: 第一周：原则和关键概念
shots.scene: 路线图第一格亮起，里面是盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The first box of the road map lights up with a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第一周，先打基础：
overlay: 第一周：原则和关键概念

shots.section_title: 第一周：原则和关键概念
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁出现三个圆圈：评估、减缓、绩效
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three connected circles with a magnifier, a shield and a check mark.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理的原则和做法，

shots.section_title: 第一周：原则和关键概念
shots.scene: 关键概念卡片一张张翻开，卡面是图标
shots.prompt_en: Blank concept cards flip over one by one, showing simple icons. No people.
shots.narration: 还有几个关键概念。

shots.section_title: 第一周：生物因子与分组
shots.scene: 显微镜下的细菌、病毒、真菌示意图标
shots.prompt_en: Simple generic icons of a bacterium, a virus particle and a fungal spore under a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 什么是生物因子？
overlay: 第一周：生物因子与分组

shots.section_title: 第一周：生物因子与分组
shots.scene: 生物因子按危害大小排成四档的阶梯
shots.prompt_en: Generic microbe icons sorted onto a four-step staircase by hazard level. No people.
shots.narration: 按危害大小，分成几个危险度分组。

shots.scene: 一张空白组织架构图，方框之间连线
shots.prompt_en: A blank organization chart of boxes connected by lines, each box with a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第一周还讲设施的组织结构。

shots.scene: 王老师指着架构图，老周和小研在旁边看
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at the organization chart while the older man and the female graduate student watch.
shots.narration: 谁负责什么，心里要有数。

shots.scene: 路线图第二格亮起，放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The second box of the road map lights up with a magnifier icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二周，学风险评估。

shots.scene: 一个密封的培养瓶静静放在架子上
shots.prompt_en: A sealed culture flask sits quietly on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 危害，是东西本身可能伤人；

shots.scene: 同一个瓶子被打开、液体飞溅的示意，红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: The same flask shown with its cap off and a splash icon, marked with a red exclamation icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风险，要看怎么操作、多大可能。

shots.section_title: 第二周：完整做一次评估
shots.scene: 评估流程四步图标：认因子、看操作、估可能、估后果
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons in a row: a microbe, a pipette, a dice and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 对一种生物因子，一步步评估：
overlay: 第二周：完整做一次评估

shots.section_title: 第二周：完整做一次评估
shots.scene: 风险矩阵格子，一个格子被点亮
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk matrix grid with one cell highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性和后果，一起定风险。

shots.section_title: 第二周：完整做一次评估
shots.scene: 小研在空白评估表上逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ticks items one by one on a blank assessment form.
shots.narration: 考虑周全，写成评估表。

shots.scene: 路线图第三格亮起，五根手指图标
shots.prompt_en: The third box of the road map lights up with an open hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三周，学怎么把风险降下来：

shots.scene: 一只手五根手指分别对应五个图标
shots.prompt_en: An open hand where each finger points to an icon: a crossed-out item, a swap arrow, a cabinet, a clipboard and a glove. No people.
shots.narration: 五类控制措施，像五根手指，

shots.scene: 五根手指握成拳头
shots.prompt_en: The five fingers close together into a firm fist. No people.
shots.narration: 合在一起用，才最有力。

shots.scene: 路线图第四格亮起，勾号图标
shots.prompt_en: The fourth box of the road map lights up with a check mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第四周，学绩效评估。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表在实验室巡查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through the laboratory with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 定下的规程，到底管不管用？

shots.scene: 检查表上大部分打勾，一项打问号，箭头回到改进
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with most items ticked and one marked with a question mark, an arrow looping back to an improvement icon. No people.
shots.narration: 去查一查，发现问题就改。

shots.scene: 路线图第五格亮起，试卷图标
shots.prompt_en: The fifth box of the road map lights up with a test paper icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第五周，用案例来考核。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着一份空白案例材料认真思考
shots.prompt_en: The young male student studies a blank case study document and thinks hard.
shots.narration: 把学到的方法，用在一个实际案例上。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿到一张空白结业证书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student receives a blank certificate of completion and smiles.
shots.narration: 完成考核，拿到结业证书。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在五格全部点亮的路线图前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the road map with all five boxes lit.
shots.narration: 四周学习，一周考核。

shots.scene: 四个图标：盾牌、放大镜、手掌、勾号
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a shield, a magnifier, an open hand and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 原则、评估、控制、绩效。

shots.scene: 案例材料和结业证书图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a case study document and a certificate of completion. No people.
shots.narration: 案例考核，完成就拿证书。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、王老师在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the safety administrator wave goodbye at the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 学好这门课，一起守安全，再见！
